picks.title: As AI agents become employees, NewCore emerges with $66M to give them identities
picks.why_it_matters: Signals an emerging infrastructure layer for enterprise AI adoption—identity and access management for AI agents could become as essential as IAM was for cloud, creating a new category for startups to build in.

picks.title: Sarvam becomes India's newest AI unicorn with $234 million funding round led by HCLTech
picks.why_it_matters: Validates the thesis that regional AI foundation model companies can reach unicorn status with enterprise backing, suggesting opportunities for similar plays in other non-US markets.

picks.title: Malaysia's AI agent-powered messaging app Respond.io raises $62.5M, eyes acquisitions
picks.why_it_matters: Per-conversation pricing for AI customer service shows a maturing business model for AI agents that aligns cost with value delivered—a pricing innovation early-stage founders should study.
